decisions.reason: A waterproof lined safety shoe range sits close to the core offer, so keeping it costs little and fits steady demand, and the missing website archives after 2019 give no sign that its value has failed to materialize.

ESD occupational shoes serve a growing electronics and industrial niche, share existing production and channels, and carry low ongoing cost, so the option is worth keeping while no negative evidence exists.
A safety shoe series is core business with low carrying cost, but series are rotated regularly in a broad portfolio with many alternatives, which gives a somewhat higher chance it is replaced.
